title: Section title block on its acid slab: ultra-black CJK, condensed caps and a giant two-digit number, with a stripe band and a rounded content slab cut at 49 degrees
use: The opening of a numbered page section, or a section card in a deck. side=right mirrors it (sections alternate). The media slot is the section's picture.

side.note: title edge; right mirrors every cut

cut_x.note: acid slab corner x / W (the cut runs down-left from it at 49 degrees)

film.note: a film strip crossing the top band

relations: Ink heights CJK : Latin : number = 1 : 0.42 : 2.7; gaps 9 and 18 units; one left (or right) edge.
The acid slab's cut and the content slab's cut are parallel at 49 degrees with a stripe band between.
The title sits on acid; the picture sits on white; nothing small on the stripes.

provenance.corpus: replay-ward case (回放街区 REPLAY WARD): our own original one-page game site and two in-game screens in the street-tape grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/street-tape/style.json provenance (reference board measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: The case's news section scaled to a 960 x 540 card; title sizes from the board's measured ink heights (45 / 19 / 115-130 px at 1920).
measured: Board: CJK ink 45 px (48-50 px type), Latin ink 19 px, number ink 115-130 px; left titles at x 290, right titles end at 1790.
Case first pass: the number ran off the acid onto the stripes (black on #222122); the slab corner moved right (cut_x 0.41-0.47).
